summary: v3.14 SAP-late polling stall fix validated. All 16 unit test groups pass (including new testEmptyOrdersInHotWindow with 6 cases). Static code review confirms tick() hot-window branches, throttle sharing, tight-loop wiring, and boundary reset all correct.
critical_code_review_comments: tick() cold-path (orders=0 and matched=0) correctly sets ctx._matchedButNoCaptcha=false (lines 1479, 1514) — no accidental tight-loop when window is closed.
tick() hot-path (orders=0 line 1470, matched=0 line 1505) correctly sets _matchedButNoCaptcha=true → main loop line 1702-1703 uses sleepMs=0 setImmediate tight loop.

globalThis.__lastWaitLog throttle (10s) is consistently shared between fetchFreshCaptcha (line 1085-1086) and both new tick() branches (lines 1472-1473, 1507-1508) — one throttle across all sources, no spam.
Boundary-crossover reset at line 1694 (globalThis.__lastWaitLog = 0) fires once per new :15/:45 window, so the new hot-window wait-log emits immediately at boundary — good UX.
bid-engine.js is 1723 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting into modules (auth/session, captcha, batcher, tick loop) in a future refactor. Not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a Node.js CLI project under /app/bikas-bidding — no HTTP server. Test = `cd /app/bikas-bidding && node tests/test-window-scheduler.js` + `node --check bid-engine.js`. Never try to run bid-engine.js (needs cookie.txt + creds.json + live SAP).
